id: \bAlder: Oh, it's over? I'm not quite in the mood, but why don't you take this instead?
en: \bAlder: Oh, it's over? I'm not quite in the mood, but why don't you take this instead?
it: \bNardo: Oh, è finita? Non sono proprio dell'umore, ma perché invece non prendi questo?

id: \bI suppose you think you will win.
en: \bI suppose you think you will win.

id: \bTrip: You're the one that made it this far? Let's see if you can even keep up.
en: \bTrip: You're the one that made it this far? Let's see if you can even keep up.
it: \bTrip: Sei tu quello che è arrivato fin qui? Vediamo se riesci almeno a starmi dietro.

id: \bTrip: It's over. No need to keep talking to each other.
en: \bTrip: It's over. No need to keep talking to each other.
it: \bTrip: È finita. Non c'è bisogno di continuare a parlarci.

id: \rIris: So you've made it this far \PN. Don't think I'm losing to a little kid like you.
en: \rIris: So you've made it this far \PN. Don't think I'm losing to a little kid like you.
it: \rIris: Quindi sei arrivato fin qui, \PN. Non pensare che perderò contro un ragazzino come te.
\rIris: Ti è andata bene, tutto qui.
